summary.text: Ten Extreme physiques are ten aptitudes above A grade. Clans keep them as a restricted secret, and holders almost always die before they can mature.

claims.text: During the Qing Mao wolf tide, Fang Yuan names Bai Ning Bing’s Northern Dark Ice Soul Physique while Bai Ning Bing holds himself at rank two against the Xiong Li group and the wolf pack, diluting higher essence and rarely using rank three Gu.

The Virtue true inheritance Fang Yuan obtained carries accumulate virtue Gu, whose most useful property is that it could modify his physique into a Righteous Virtue Physique, only inferior to the ten extreme physiques and without their flaws.

The best A grade aptitude can store ninety-nine percent primeval essence. Any of these physiques holds a full hundred percent. That load is too perfect for heaven to tolerate easily. Holders must keep cultivating to reinforce aperture walls against the full essence load, so their rise is unusually fast, and each advance increases pressure again.
After rank three the stored sea itself nurtures as hard as deliberate nurturing, and the climb accelerates with rank until the aperture fails.
Recovery of primeval essence is supreme, much stronger than ordinary A grade rates.

A rank six outcome would let such a Gu Master dominate same-stage foes and even fight above rank, but that outcome is rare. When the aperture finally detonates, the blast is treated as heaven-defying and extreme in power.
Bai clan records also call them absolute death talents for that end-stage self-destruction.
The self-detonation grows sharply stronger as the holder’s own cultivation rises, so a higher-ranked holder’s blast far outstrips a lower-ranked one’s.
The physiques also carry unusually abundant human qi; an ordinary Gu Master can only approach the same abundance by reaching grandmaster attainment in a path.
Liu Shu Xian, wife of Red Lotus Demon Venerable, holds one of the ten extreme physiques. She uses it to block his rank nine tribulation and dies from the cost.

Ren Zu’s legends name ten children, and Fang Yuan reads each child as standing for one ultimate aptitude. The eldest son is Verdant Great Sun and the second daughter is Desolate Ancient Moon; among the ten is Northern Dark Ice Soul. In those stories the children did not live long. Bai Ning Bing holds the Northern Dark Ice Soul Physique during the Qing Mao wolf tide.
A fourth child, Boundless Forest Samsara, is left behind inside Ordinary Abyss. No chapter attaches the word physique to her or names a living holder of her aptitude.
She survives there alone for years.
A seventh child, Great Strength True Martial, is created after Ren Zu faces his greatest Predicament.

During the Qing Mao investigation stretch, Tie Ruo Nan argues only a ten extreme physique explains Fang Yuan’s calm, his lack of need for cultivation resources, his lack of envy, and his concealment of his aptitude; Gu Yue Bo names it the Ancient Moon Desolate Yin physique. First gen Gu Yue’s will predicts a Gu Master with the Ancient Moon Desolate Yin body and orders such a physique brought to the blood pond graveyard coffin, where a method to curb the ten extreme weakness is said to sleep.

Tie Ruo Nan later assumes Fang Yuan holds Desolate Ancient Moon physique and that the ten extreme weakness would already have killed him, then corrects herself that Bai Ning Bing held Northern Dark Ice Soul physique instead.

Hei Bai names the ten extreme physique Great Strength True Martial on Hei Lou Lan while talking with Hei Cheng in Xiao Hun blessed land. Hei Cheng says Great Strength True Martial physique needs a strength path Immortal Gu to advance to Gu Immortal realm, and that Hei tribe has none.
Mo Yao says Old Immortal Kong Jue researched apertures deeply and helped the ten extreme physiques become immortals. Before him, no person of the ten extreme physiques had risen to immortal.
Kong Jue was one of the Remote Antiquity Era’s three refinement path supreme grandmasters, and his research let holders of the ten extreme physiques ascend and form super grade blessed lands.

Feng Jin Huang’s revival material names Fairy Lian Xiang, a past Spirit Affinity House fairy, as holding Desolate Ancient Moon physique. Ambushing enemies made her a zombie at rank five; she later succeeded in immortal ascension, and heavenly tribulation with earthly calamity purified the zombie body.

During the Luo Po Valley breakout, Old Lord Can Yang names the Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance physique on a mysterious black-robed Gu Immortal. The text identifies that holder as a rank seven immortal zombie among the ten extreme physiques.
At Yi Tian Mountain, Southern Border Gu Immortals name a black-robed formation member a ten extreme immortal zombie of Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance.

Peng Shi Long shouts Northern Dark Ice Soul as another immortal zombie raises a crystalline ice wall; snow war tribulation lightning falls after and pierces the wall. A further black-robed formation member is named Carefree Wisdom Heart Physique, another immortal zombie of the ten extreme physiques. The four immortals list Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance, Northern Dark Ice Soul, and Carefree Wisdom Heart among ten extreme physiques appearing one after another, and judge the formation uses those physiques for its power. A Great Strength True Martial immortal zombie also appears in the same formation stretch.
Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord judges the formation’s reliance on the physiques’ dao marks still short of one strength path member, and calls a true gathering of all ten a thorny prospect.

At Yi Tian Mountain, Old Man Yan Shi names Ying Wu Xie Pure Dream Reality Seeker Physique and calls that form the greatest accomplishment of his dream path research. Southern Border Gu Immortals read Ying Wu Xie’s aura as showing he does not have one of the ten extreme physiques, even while other extreme physique immortal zombies stand in Shadow Sect’s formation.

While inspecting the sovereign immortal fetus Gu body, Fang Yuan lists Great Strength True Martial Physique, Northern Dark Ice Soul Physique, Verdant Great Sun Physique, and Desolate Ancient Moon Physique among the ten extreme physiques. Once a person of the ten extreme physiques becomes a Gu Immortal, as with Hei Lou Lan, they obtain a super grade blessed land whose starting territory is over 6700 km2 and does not exceed 13000 km2.

Such a blessed land runs time at about one part to forty against the outside world, faster than a high grade blessed land’s one to thirty but slower than the sovereign immortal aperture’s one to sixty.

Fang Yuan learns from Shadow Sect’s inheritance that You Chan holds Myriad Gold Wondrous Essence Physique, one of the ten extreme physiques. Shadow Sect searched for all ten while refining sovereign immortal fetus Gu and already held that physique, so it left her alone. The Legends of Ren Zu names a child Myriad Gold Wondrous Essence in the same framing used for the other extreme aptitudes.

After Feng Jin Huang perfects Pure Dream Reality Seeker Transformation in Fang Yuan’s previous life, Heavenly Court obtains the perfect Pure Dream Reality Seeker Physique and treats it as the eleventh extreme physique.
Shadow Sect and Zombie Alliance spend years of accumulated resources, including the ten extreme physiques, to create sovereign immortal fetus Gu.
